release.source_note: Original ForLanguage targeted practice authored from the user's Aptis practice results, error patterns, knowledge map and recent-review topic signals. Recalled live-test wording is not reproduced.

grammar.question: The office lights are off and nobody is answering. They ___ home already.
grammar.explanation_vi: Có bằng chứng hiện tại để suy luận gần như chắc chắn về quá khứ → must have + V3.

grammar.question: You ___ extra copies; the organiser had already printed enough for everyone.
grammar.explanation_vi: Việc đã làm nhưng không cần thiết → needn't have + V3.

grammar.question: Mina was in another country yesterday, so she ___ the meeting in person.
grammar.explanation_vi: Bằng chứng khiến khả năng đó không thể xảy ra → can't have + V3.

grammar.question: The parcel was due on Friday. It ___ by now, but the tracking page has not changed.
grammar.explanation_vi: Should have + V3 có thể diễn tả kỳ vọng đáng lẽ đã xảy ra.

grammar.question: The warning was very small. The technician ___ it when checking the screen.
grammar.explanation_vi: Khả năng phủ định trong quá khứ → might not have + V3; mustn't là cấm đoán.

grammar.question: The attachment is missing from the email. It ___ before the message was sent.
grammar.explanation_vi: Attachment nhận hành động → modal perfect passive: may have been + V3.

grammar.question: If I had taken that internship last year, I ___ in Singapore now.
grammar.explanation_vi: Điều kiện quá khứ → kết quả hiện tại: if + had V3, would + bare infinitive.

grammar.question: If he were more organised, he ___ the deadline yesterday.
grammar.explanation_vi: Đặc điểm hiện tại giải thích kết quả quá khứ → if + past simple, would have + V3.

grammar.question: I wish I ___ more confident when speaking in meetings.
grammar.explanation_vi: Trái với hiện tại → wish + past simple; were phù hợp văn phong chuẩn.

grammar.question: She wishes she ___ the instructions more carefully before submitting the form.
grammar.explanation_vi: Hối tiếc về quá khứ → wish + past perfect.

grammar.question: I wish the neighbours ___ their music down after midnight.
grammar.explanation_vi: Muốn hành vi của người khác thay đổi → wish + would + V.

grammar.question: If we had checked the route earlier, we ___ lost now.
grammar.explanation_vi: Sai sót quá khứ gây trạng thái hiện tại → would + bare infinitive.

grammar.question: This time tomorrow, I ___ the speaking section of the test.
grammar.explanation_vi: Hành động đang diễn ra tại một mốc cụ thể trong tương lai → future continuous.

grammar.question: By the time the workshop starts, we ___ all the equipment.
grammar.explanation_vi: Hoàn thành trước một mốc tương lai → future perfect.

grammar.question: By September, she ___ at the company for exactly five years.
grammar.explanation_vi: Nhấn mạnh thời lượng kéo dài đến một mốc tương lai → future perfect continuous.

grammar.question: When I arrived, the presentation ___, so I quietly sat at the back.
grammar.explanation_vi: Một hành động hoàn tất trước thời điểm quá khứ khác → past perfect.

grammar.question: The ground was wet because it ___ all night.
grammar.explanation_vi: Quá trình kéo dài trước một thời điểm quá khứ và giải thích kết quả nhìn thấy → past perfect continuous.

grammar.question: While the team ___ the first proposal, the manager received an urgent call.
grammar.explanation_vi: Hành động nền đang diễn ra khi sự kiện khác xen vào → past continuous.

grammar.question: She asked me where I ___ the previous summer.
grammar.explanation_vi: Reported question dùng trật tự câu khẳng định và thường backshift về past perfect.

grammar.question: The trainer advised us ___ a short break every hour.
grammar.explanation_vi: advise + object + to-infinitive.

grammar.question: The device is believed ___ because of overheating during the test.
grammar.explanation_vi: Sự việc được tin là đã xảy ra trước thời điểm báo cáo → to have + V3.

grammar.question: All applications must ___ before Friday afternoon.
grammar.explanation_vi: Chủ ngữ nhận hành động với modal → modal + be + V3.

grammar.question: He said that he ___ the file the day before.
grammar.explanation_vi: Past event được báo lại sau đó → backshift về past perfect.

grammar.question: The committee suggested ___ the event to a larger room.
grammar.explanation_vi: suggest + V-ing là cấu trúc chuẩn khi đề xuất hành động.

grammar.question: The new instructions are surprisingly ___ and easy to follow.
grammar.explanation_vi: Sau linking verb are cần adjective bổ nghĩa cho chủ ngữ → clear.

grammar.question: The team completed the safety check very ___.
grammar.explanation_vi: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ completed → adverb carefully.

grammar.question: The updated interface is ___ easier to use than the old one.
grammar.explanation_vi: far/much/a lot + comparative → far easier.

grammar.question: We need to ___ a practical solution before the meeting ends.
grammar.explanation_vi: come up with = nghĩ ra/đề xuất một ý tưởng hoặc giải pháp.

grammar.question: The research team will ___ a small pilot study next month.
grammar.explanation_vi: carry out = thực hiện một nghiên cứu/nhiệm vụ.

grammar.question: The manager promised to ___ the complaint and reply by Friday.
grammar.explanation_vi: look into = điều tra/xem xét một vấn đề.

vocabulary.question: The project team must ___ responsibility for the delay.
vocabulary.explanation_vi: Cụm tự nhiên là take responsibility for.

vocabulary.question: The new timetable may ___ difficulties for members who work late.
The extra fee would help ___ the operating costs of the weekend service.
vocabulary.explanation_vi: cover the operating costs = trang trải chi phí vận hành.

vocabulary.question: Which phrase is closest in meaning to 'play an important role in'?
vocabulary.explanation_vi: play a vital role in là paraphrase tự nhiên của play an important role in.

vocabulary.question: Which phrase best replaces 'becoming more popular'?
vocabulary.explanation_vi: gaining popularity = trở nên phổ biến hơn.

vocabulary.question: Which phrasal verb means 'solve or organise a problem successfully'?
vocabulary.explanation_vi: sort out = giải quyết/sắp xếp ổn thỏa.

vocabulary.question: Which phrasal verb means 'mention a topic for discussion'?
vocabulary.explanation_vi: bring up = nêu/đề cập một chủ đề.

vocabulary.question: Which phrasal verb means 'exclude a possibility after consideration'?
vocabulary.explanation_vi: rule out = loại trừ một khả năng.

vocabulary.question: Which phrase is most suitable in a formal email to a club manager?
options: I am writing to express my concerns about the change.
Hey, this change is pretty bad.
You guys should fix this now.
vocabulary.explanation_vi: Câu A phù hợp register trang trọng và mục đích nêu quan ngại.

vocabulary.question: Which phrase introduces a practical solution most naturally?
options: To address this problem, I would like to propose an alternative.
On the contrary, I have a problem.
vocabulary.explanation_vi: To address this problem... là cách chuyển sang giải pháp rõ ràng và trang trọng.

reading_part2.title: Community garden volunteer day
reading_part2.fixed_first: Our neighbourhood garden had been unused for several months, so a group of residents decided to improve it together.

sentences.A: By lunchtime, the paths were clear and the empty beds were ready for planting.
sentences.B: Before anyone started digging, the organiser divided us into small teams and explained the safety rules.
sentences.C: Once the preparation was complete, one team removed weeds while another collected old plastic and broken pots.
sentences.D: A few weeks later, the first vegetables appeared, which encouraged more neighbours to join the project.
sentences.E: At the end of the afternoon, we watered the new plants and agreed on a weekly maintenance schedule.

reading_part2.explanation_vi: Chuỗi logic: tổ chức và hướng dẫn trước → bắt đầu dọn → kết quả đến trưa → kết thúc ngày và lập lịch → vài tuần sau có kết quả. Dấu hiệu mạnh: Before anyone started, Once..., By lunchtime, At the end..., A few weeks later.

reading_part2.title: Preparing a student technology workshop
reading_part2.fixed_first: Our technology club agreed to run a beginner workshop for students who had never used coding tools before.

sentences.A: During the session, each group followed the same short exercise while volunteers moved around the room to help.
sentences.B: After testing the activities ourselves, we simplified two tasks that had been too difficult for complete beginners.
sentences.C: First, we listed the basic skills the participants would need and selected three simple activities.
sentences.D: The following week, several participants emailed us to say they had continued practising at home.
sentences.E: Finally, we ended with a short question-and-answer session and shared links to free learning resources.

reading_part2.explanation_vi: First mở kế hoạch → After testing liên kết với activities → During the session là khi workshop diễn ra → Finally kết thúc buổi → The following week là kết quả sau đó.

reading_part2.title: Changing a daily travel routine
reading_part2.fixed_first: For years, I drove to work every day even though the journey was becoming slower and more expensive.

sentences.A: After comparing several options, I decided to try the bus for one month before making a permanent change.
sentences.B: By the end of the first week, I realised that the journey took only ten minutes longer than driving.
sentences.C: The main reason I reconsidered my routine was a new express bus route near my home.
sentences.D: Since then, I have used the car only when I need to carry heavy equipment.
sentences.E: More importantly, I could read or answer messages during the trip instead of concentrating on traffic.

reading_part2.explanation_vi: Lý do thay đổi → quyết định thử → đánh giá sau một tuần → lợi ích bổ sung → thói quen hiện tại. Đại từ/quan hệ: The main reason, After comparing, By the end..., More importantly, Since then.

reading_part2.title: Improving a shared study room
reading_part2.fixed_first: Students had complained that the shared study room was often too noisy for concentrated work.

sentences.A: The trial showed that most students respected the signs, although the first few days required several reminders.
sentences.B: As a result, the committee decided to keep the zones permanently and add more power sockets near the quiet desks.
sentences.C: The student committee therefore proposed dividing the room into a silent area and a discussion area.
sentences.D: For two weeks, coloured signs were used to mark the two zones while staff recorded comments from users.
sentences.E: At the end of the trial, the feedback was largely positive, especially from students preparing for exams.

reading_part2.explanation_vi: Problem → therefore proposal → trial implementation → result during trial → feedback at end → As a result quyết định lâu dài.

reading_part3.title: Three views on learning new skills

people.label: A
people.name: Lena
people.text: I learn best when I can experiment on my own first. A structured course is useful later, especially when I need feedback on mistakes that I cannot identify myself. Short courses suit me because I lose motivation if a programme continues for many months.

people.label: B
people.name: Omar
people.text: For me, learning is mainly social. I remember ideas better when I discuss them with other people, and regular group meetings help me stay disciplined. I do use online videos, but mostly to review something after a teacher or classmate has explained it.

people.label: C
people.name: Priya
people.text: My work schedule changes every week, so flexibility matters more than anything else. I prefer online courses that let me study at different times. I also like programmes with a practical project because completing something real gives me a clear sense of progress.

statements.text: This person values being able to choose when to study.
statements.paraphrase: flexibility matters; study at different times

statements.text: This person finds discussion with others especially helpful.
statements.paraphrase: learning is mainly social; discuss ideas

statements.text: This person prefers courses that are fairly short.
statements.paraphrase: short courses suit me; long programmes reduce motivation

statements.text: This person likes producing a concrete result while learning.
This person often starts by learning independently.
This person uses online material mainly for revision.
This person believes other people can help reveal unnoticed errors.
statements.paraphrase: feedback on mistakes I cannot identify myself

people.label: A
people.name: Ben
people.text: I enjoy large public events because they bring energy to a neighbourhood and attract people who might not normally meet. However, organisers should keep the programme simple; when there are too many activities, visitors spend more time deciding what to do than enjoying themselves.

people.label: B
people.name: Sofia
people.text: Small events are more useful in my opinion because people actually talk to one another. I would rather attend a monthly workshop than one huge festival each year. The location is important too: somewhere close to public transport makes it easier for older residents to participate.

people.label: C
people.name: Kai
people.text: I do not care much about the size of an event as long as local people help shape it. Organisers should ask residents what they want before making final plans. I also think a mix of free and paid activities can work well if the basic programme remains accessible to everyone.

statements.text: This person thinks residents should influence the programme before decisions are final.
statements.paraphrase: ask residents what they want before final plans

statements.text: This person prefers events where participants have more opportunity to speak to each other.
This person thinks too much choice can reduce enjoyment.
statements.paraphrase: too many activities; spend time deciding

statements.text: This person supports holding activities regularly rather than only once a year.
statements.paraphrase: monthly workshop rather than one huge festival each year

statements.text: This person accepts charging for some activities under certain conditions.
statements.paraphrase: mix of free and paid; basics accessible

statements.text: This person sees a benefit in bringing together people who do not usually meet.
statements.paraphrase: attract people who might not normally meet

statements.text: This person specifically mentions access for older people.
statements.paraphrase: public transport; easier for older residents
